meta.title: 어순 변화
meta.note: 교재 p.60과 정답·해설 p.42의 대표 Q01~Q04 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 so/neither/nor/there 도치 중심의 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: It takes some time for babies to begin to walk, and so does achieving your goals, so you must not get discouraged when you don't see progress right away.
items.prompt: so does 뒤에서 실제 주어 역할을 하는 부분을 드래그하세요.
items.explanation: <so + V + S>는 ‘S도 역시 그렇다’의 도치 어순입니다. does 뒤의 동명사구 achieving your goals가 주어입니다.
items.memory: so/neither/nor 뒤에서는 동사와 주어의 위치를 다시 확인

items.sentence: In all honesty, office workers would not enjoy their environments quite as much with someone constantly looking over their shoulder, and sometimes neither do the students.
items.prompt: with someone constantly ___ over their shoulder에 알맞은 형태를 고르세요.
items.explanation: with의 목적어 someone이 ‘보는’ 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 looking이 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: In all honesty, office workers would not enjoy their environments quite as much with someone constantly looking over their shoulder, and sometimes neither do the students.
items.prompt: sometimes neither do the students의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: <neither + V + S>는 앞의 부정 내용에 이어 ‘S도 역시 그렇지 않다’라는 의미를 나타냅니다.

items.sentence: Science is not a means for finding quick and certain facts, but a slow, methodical process that is prone to misstep, so the process is not always reliable, nor are researchers 100 percent objective.
items.prompt: nor are ___ 100 percent objective에서 도치된 주어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: <nor + V + S> 도치에서 are 뒤의 researchers가 주어입니다. 앞 절의 부정 의미가 이어집니다.

items.sentence: As statistics show that fliers aged 45 to 74 have fewer accidents than those between 26 and 44, and there exists no proof that pilots in their 60's are less able than those in their 20's, we can conclude that age and working ability are proportional in pilots.
items.prompt: there ___ no proof에서 알맞은 동사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: there가 문두에 놓인 도치구문에서 실제 주어는 단수 no proof이므로 단수동사 exists가 알맞습니다.
